answer: Admission auction is a deposit on scarce flats. 100 slots per epoch; bids sealed, each locks 3 epochs, a 2-epoch window burns fakes. Losers refunded minus 2%; winners pay clearing. A beacon bid of 60 marks the floor; doubling demand doubles the price. A horizon of bids from one wallet clusters and flags; bulk buyers bid against themselves. The lantern: 1,000 identities cost 60,000, 120,000 doubled. Forgery pays market rate.
